exposure: SpO2 at five minutes after birth
cohort: Preterm infants born between July 2014 and July 2018 at Peyton Manning Children's Hospital with gestational age <29 weeks.
finding: Infants with SpO2 < 80% at five minutes after birth had lower Apgar scores, lower heart rates, lower median SpO2, higher oxygen administration, and were less likely to have spontaneous respirations compared to infants with SpO2 >= 80%.
